arguments.exit_condition: Optional intended review or exit condition
arguments.reason: Optional description of the observed condition

command_request_example.note: Illustrative protocol values, not recommended sizes; decimals come from session.describe.

tools.broker.order: Own order lifecycle and confirmed simulated fill records.
tools.broker.quote: Exact-input simulated quote against the current model state.
tools.broker.submit: Optional reason and exit_condition metadata are bounded to 512 characters each and included in idempotency. Submit an exact-input simulated swap with min-output, deadline and idempotency key.
tools.clock.advance: Advance virtual time to a relative time or the next observable event (bounded).
tools.clock.wait: Wait until until_ms or a delayed one-shot notification. Up to 32 conditions: new_pool (since_ms, min_visible_trades, min_numeraire_depth_raw), price_cross (pool_id, direction above/below, price), liquidity_below (pool_id, depth_raw), order_terminal (order_id). Never submits orders.
tools.market.candles: Generic OHLCV over visible trades with explicit completeness handling.
tools.market.liquidity: Current modeled liquidity facts for a supported pool (CPMM reserves, or CL sqrt price / tick / active liquidity / virtual depth; model-labelled).
tools.market.restrictions: Available individual restriction observations or explicit unknown/unsupported.
tools.market.trades: Bounded visible trade history ending at or before virtual now.
tools.markets.get: Time-qualified metadata and available current observations for one pool.
tools.markets.list: Paginated currently discoverable pools with point-in-time filters; sort by newest, most_traded or recently_traded to find launches worth a look.
tools.portfolio.get: Available/reserved/pending balances, holdings and valuation status.
tools.session.describe: Capabilities, limits, relative horizon, numeraire, assumptions and virtual clock.
tools.session.finish: Stop agent decisions and apply the fixed terminal reporting procedure.
tools.session.snapshot: Visible market activity, freshness, coverage, modeled depth, portfolio and orders. Use format=compact for columnar market/discovery rows suited to LLMs; format=full preserves nested detail (legacy default). Prefer limit=25 and pool_ids for a watchlist. Accepts since_ms, window_ms, stale_after_ms, limit and market/discovery/order cursors. Each compact items row follows its columns list; quantities remain exact strings.
